snippet.title: Under the Heavens: A Kingdom Manga–Inspired Narrative RPG
snippet.description:
Under the Heavens is a narrative-driven RPG set in China's Warring States. Every choice shapes your rise from a nameless soldier to a legendary general.

Every campaign is a series of assignments, skirmishes, and battles. Each turn of the page presents a choice: Who do you risk? What do you sacrifice? Your officers live or die based on your decisions and the dice. The dead stay dead.

This is not a story about saving the world. This is a war story you shape, battle by battle, scar by scar.

Follow the Kickstarter Campaign: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/aprilmay/under-the-heavens

Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4419240/Under_the_Heavens_Warring_States_Saga/
